specific_objectives: 16.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain the optical holography and acoustic emission inspection

practical: Demonstration of Laser alignment and Interferogram formation; Safety precautions regarding laser eye protection and beam paths; Instructor supervision of trainee setup procedures
intro_questions: What is the fundamental difference between a photograph and a hologram?
Define the term 'interference' in the context of wave optics.
Why is a coherent light source required for holography?

topics: Role of reference and object beams
development.content:
Basic principle of optical holography
Role of reference and object beams
Formation of interference pattern
Recording medium requirements

Procedure for setting up construction
Laser alignment and beam splitting
Interferogram advantages and disadvantages
Re-construction of the hologram

Applications of holography in inspection
Comparison with acoustic emission
Troubleshooting common setup errors
Safety protocols during operation

summary_questions: Explain how the re-construction process reveals the original wavefront.
List two specific advantages of using interferograms for defect detection.
Describe one critical safety precaution when handling the laser source.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of optical holography discussed in this lesson can be applied to the next lesson plan (LP 02) regarding advanced non-destructive testing methods.
